diagnosis.failure_mode: Advantages are being computed as zero or near-zero throughout training, eliminating the policy gradient signal. This is evidenced by: (1) policy_loss remaining at effectively zero, (2) approx_kl always at 0.0 (indicating no policy change), (3) clipfrac always at 0.0 (no clipping because no divergence), (4) entropy staying at maximum 0.693 (random policy), and (5) episodic returns remaining flat. The value function loss remains high (~15-30) while advantages provide no useful learning signal, suggesting the returns are not being properly converted to advantages (likely GAE or advantage normalization is broken, or advantages are incorrectly being set to all zeros).
